title: Did You Know E-Commerce Report Ad on Green Paper Stack
whatItIs: A vivid green radial background with a stack of ruled paper sheets and a dark green clipboard held by a black binder clip, showing a cream card 'Did you know? Nigerian men would rather buy gadgets than clothes for themselves?' with a smiling man on a laptop and phone, a big white 'BUMPA E-COMMERCE REPORT' with a gold price-tag icon, a small stat, and vertical 2026 and 2025 tabs on the right edge.
whatItMeans: Turning a data report into a physical folder makes a stat feel like a document you can pick up, and green is the brand throughout.
techniques: Report shown as a clipped folder on paper
3D gold tag icon beside the title
Cream inner card over dark green
Radial green glow behind the object

vocabulary.definition: A document shown on a clipboard with a binder clip.
A tab on the edge of a page labelling a section.
A surprising fact used to invite a click.
